title: Command-Line Calculator
objective: Create a calculator that accepts numbers and arithmetic operations.

milestones.title: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division
acceptance_criteria: Document the expected result and one boundary case.
Keep the implementation readable, testable, and aligned to the project runtime.

milestones.title: Repeated calculations
acceptance_criteria: Document the expected result and one boundary case.
Keep the implementation readable, testable, and aligned to the project runtime.

milestones.title: Input validation and meaningful errors
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate: Input validation and meaningful errors.
Document the expected result and one boundary case.
Keep the implementation readable, testable, and aligned to the project runtime.

stretch_features: Add automated regression tests for important edge cases.
Add a short architecture note describing module boundaries and failure handling.

tests.name: Functional behavior
criteria: Required features work for representative inputs.
Expected results and failure behavior are documented.

tests.name: Reliability and security
criteria: Invalid input and expected external failures are handled.
No real credentials or personal data are committed.

tests.name: Reproducibility
criteria: Another developer can follow the setup instructions.
Build/test commands and supported versions are stated.

review_method: Human-reviewed rubric supported by local tests. This project content does not claim the platform executes arbitrary Kotlin.
status_note: Draft project based on Section D of Kotlin.pdf. Review and test the implementation before publishing.
